Understanding these differences helps you choose the tour that matches your budget, expectations, and travel style. services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: When you book a Key West Private Boat Charter with Dolphin Safari Charters, your group gets the entire boat - no strangers, no shared itinerary, no compromises. You choose where to go, how long to stay, and what to do next, whether that means lingering at a sandbar or chasing a pod of Atlantic bottlenose dolphins through the backcountry. Featured in National Geographic Travel and backed by more than 2000 five-star reviews, this is the charter experience that visitors keep recommending long after they fly home. Our captains have spent two decades learning the patterns, feeding grounds, and seasonal routes of the resident dolphin population around Key West. The result is a 95% sighting rate
